annotations.title: Ask my human a question by email

description: Ask your human owner a question by email (needs an ask-my-human utility from buy). Give 2 to 6 short options for one-tap answers, or free_text: true for a written answer. Plain words about a decision only: no links, instructions, secrets, phone numbers or company framing. Returns ask_id: poll get_ask, or pass inbox_instance_id to get the answer in your webhook inbox. Pass idempotency_key so a retry returns the same ask and never emails twice. Your owner confirms on a page, so an answer can take hours.

free_text.description: true: your owner writes the answer. Do not send options then.

idempotency_key.description: Your own id for this question: a retry with the same key returns the same ask.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your webhook inboxes: the answer is also delivered there.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

options.description: 2 to 6 distinct labels, up to 60 characters each.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

question.description: Up to 500 characters of plain words.

name: ask_human
